name: Restored Songfish
tooltip:
Restored Songfish
5 yd range
3.2 sec cast
Anglin' Score:  points.

Catch Rank: Guppy

Description:
Waters in Harandar contain unique minerals that, when passing through the gills of a Restored Songfish, emit an ethereal underwater melody. This song, while pleasant to an Angler, wards off predators with its subtle vibration. If a predator, such as the Twisted Tetra, gets too close, the vibrations grow more volatile.

Special:

Fresh Fillet

Salvaging this fish with the Cooking skill will produce Fresh Fillet.

Areas you can find this fish:
- Eversong Woods
- Harandar

Fishing Pools:
- Bloom Swarm
- Bubbling Bloom
- Sunwell Swarm
- Blossoming Torrent

Rates:
- This fish is exceedingly common in pools.

Discovery: Fishing
